mailbox_name.description: Name of the mailbox folder created for vCalendar meetings; matches documented UI folder name.

meetings_folder_name.description: Name of the subfolder under mailbox where meetings are stored; matches documented 'Meetings' inbox.

enable_webcal.description: Whether webCal (i.e., CalDAV/web-based calendar) subscription support is enabled. Note: Per claws-mail-vcalendar-plugin(7), this is controlled via GUI (folder context menu), not a persistent config file setting — this variable reflects potential future config usage.
